quests.first_light: Set a floor lamp in the corner and give it power.
quests.first_light_done:
Click — and a warm pool of light woke up in the corner, the first these walls have seen.
You can't screw a bulb into the sky — so you carried the light in yourself, in your own hands, up three flights of stairs.
The concrete stepped back exactly one circle of light. That circle is what you'll be coming home to now.
quests.mother_in_law: You're sleeping here tonight — set the bed where you'll lie.
quests.mother_in_law_done:
The bed is older than the flat: hauled up from the old life, the headboard wouldn't fit in the lift — took two trips.
No ceiling above it yet, somebody else's dusk instead.
But the dent in the mattress is yours, familiar down to the last spring. Lie down — and you'll know you've moved in for good.
quests.aquarium_gift: The neighbour palmed off an aquarium — plug its pump into a socket.
quests.aquarium_gift_done:
The neighbour from upstairs handed it over right at the door: "nowhere to keep it, and throwing it out feels wrong" — tired of hauling the water, more like.
A Sputnik aquarium, glass clouded with limescale, three fish older than the renovation.
You plugged in the pump. And it burbles.
The first voice in this home that isn't yours — a bubbly one, on till morning.
quests.antenna: Move the TV to the window and power it — the signal's better there.
quests.antenna_done:
The grey snow on the screen suddenly settled into a picture: a newsreader, the weather, somebody's calm, even voice.
And a small chill: you never tuned anything — so how?
Then you see it — an old antenna wire taped to the window frame. Run out to the window by whoever lived here before you.
Not for himself, it turns out. For you.
quests.cold: Cold seeps from the wall — hang a rug over it.
quests.cold_done:
You lifted the rug to the wall — and the nail was already there. Driven in exactly right, long ago, not by you.
You hung it, smoothed the pile — and the wall went quiet, stopped breathing cold down your back.
The pattern is the one everyone had: deer, diamonds, a middle worn thin.
So the one before you froze here too, and warmed himself the same way. One nail — and it feels like a handshake across the years.
quests.guests: Call the housewarming — a table and three seats around it.
quests.guests_done:
The guests left past midnight — and it stayed behind on the table. A lava lamp, nobody's, and now yours.
It needs no socket: there's a battery inside, you can carry its light into the darkest corner.
Set it on the table. Or a stool, the TV stand, the very top of the china cabinet — wherever you like.
And let the thick warm glow drift about the room till morning.
quests.cat: Put a stool by the window — someone will need to watch the yard.
quests.cat_done:
A cat walked in through the doorway without asking. Grey, from the yard, one ear torn.
He jumped onto the stool by the window as if it were his — a spot worn in back in somebody else's time.
You whistled — he turned, to another whistle, an older one. But he stayed. Accepted it.
Now two of you sit by the window: you, and the one who moved in without a lease.
quests.crystal: Push the china cabinet to a wall — get the crystal up off the floor.
quests.crystal_done:
The cabinet stood against the wall like it grew roots — no leaving this place lightly now.
Behind the glass, somebody's best service for twelve: taken out once, for a wedding, never actually drunk from.
So before you, this room was also waiting for a full house of guests.
Nobody to pour for yet. Let it stand. It glitters — and that's a holiday already.
quests.concert: Catch the concert off the air — tape player by the TV, both plugged in.
quests.concert_done:
You set the tape player by the TV, pressed record, and sat guard over the cassette — afraid to sneeze onto the tape.
At minute forty-two the neighbour downstairs started his drill. Right into the solo.
Now you own the world's only recording of that concert with a hammer drill in it.
Let it be. It's yours — from this evening, from this home.
quests.seedlings: Set the plant by the window — let it reach for the light.
quests.seedlings_done:
You set the pot by the window — and there was already soil in it. Dry, but soil.
So something was grown here before you too, at this same window, facing the same yard.
You watered it, nudged it closer to the light. Grow.
Someone started this — you get to see it through. The home has a future living in it now.
quests.neighbors: Put both armchairs on the rug — quieter for the neighbours below.
quests.neighbors_done:
The neighbours did knock after all — not on the wall, on the door. Holding a round rug: "for the new place — we had a spare lying about."
Worn along the edge, a pattern in the middle — a flower, or maybe a medallion; somebody's, and now yours.
Lay it on the floor where the daylight falls — and the room will stop humming underfoot.
This one isn't for hanging, it's for the floor. Put it down and cross it barefoot.
quests.free_cat_spot: The cat has nowhere to sit — clear his stool by the window

reno_task.debris_done:
You carried the last bag out the door — and the place went hollow and clean, like after guests you never invited.
What's left is bare concrete and an echo. The echo is yours now.
reno_task.window_done:
The window settled into its frame — and the yard surfaced behind the glass: panel blocks, wires, a lonely streetlamp.
The wind stayed outside, where it belongs. The room stopped being the street.
reno_task.floor_done:
The parquet lay down board to board, still smelling of varnish and work.
You walked corner to corner — no hum, no echo answering back. The floor is almost home already.
reno_task.walls_done:
The wallpaper covered the concrete — tiny flowers, same as everyone had in those years.
The room breathed out. The renovation is over — the home begins. Time to hang a rug and live.

cinema.card_1: Someone has warmed this evening here before.
cinema.card_2: November outside the glass, a lamp in the room. That's the whole arrangement.
cinema.card_3: The window went dark slower than the day.

menu.subtitle: endless November outside — a warm lamp in the room

ui.restart_confirm_text:
Erase everything and go back to bare concrete?
All you've settled in, you'll have to settle again.

ui.hint_pickup: Tap an item on the floor to pick it back up
ui.hint_reno_debris: The builders left a mess — clear the piles: tap them

ui.quests_all_done: All tasks done! A proper housewarming 🎉
ui.extension_unlocked_text:
You've powered everything in this home that could hum or glow.
For that — an extension cord. Set it on any cell of the floor
and plug things in even in the far corner — no more hugging the walls.
ui.first_light_text:
Look up — there's no ceiling. Just sky: somebody else's dusk, wires, November.
You can't screw a bulb into the sky — light in this home has to be carried in by hand.
Set down the floor lamp and give it power. Let a warm pool light up in the corner — that's what people come home to.
ui.welcome_text:
So here it is — a flat. Your own, for the first time.
For now it's just concrete, echo, and the mess the builders left behind.
Clean up after them, lay the parquet, hang the wallpaper.
Then settle in. Comfort won't gather itself.
Try to fill the comfort meter to the top — that's when this becomes home.
ui.housewarming_text:
Well, that's it.
The bare walls have grown things, and the things have grown warmth.
Outside it's the same November, the same lights in the panel blocks across the yard —
only now they shine for someone who is home.
The kettle hums, the rug is on the wall, the cat sits on his stool by the window.
This is what home is. Happy housewarming.
ui.trophy_text:
The home is done. You could have stopped — but here, one more thing, perfectly useless.
A pink flamingo bent out of neon tube. They used to hang these over cocktail bars — you'll hang yours over bare concrete.
It needs no socket: it burns on its own, humming softly like a fridge behind the wall.
Put it on the wall — and let your own little pink south glow through the endless November.
ui.light_tip_text:
Light is your brush in this home.
Don't pile all the lamps into one corner: the floor lamp here, the TV there, the aquarium in the far nook.
Let little islands of warmth settle across the room — and the dark will have nowhere left to pool.
Place them the way a painter places highlights.
ui.tip_rotate: You can rotate the item — with this button
ui.tip_quests: Your things to do around the home are here. Take them in order.
